proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11742 vidyut explicitly gives Gujarati vīj and Punjabi bijj lightning. Bare bij/vij selects this noun; vidyullatā 11745 contains the distinct bijlī/bijurī extended series. Exact survey form bij is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3208 kukkuṭa explicitly gives Oriya kukuṛā, Gujarati kukṛɔ/kukṛī and Hindi kukṛā/kukṛī cock/hen. The survey chicken forms match those masculine/feminine continuations of the expressive family. Exact survey form kukḍa is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
